_doc: Offerings (Affinity, scripts/dialogue/affinity.gd): pool gift.<speaker> plays after each offering; gift_<speaker>_<n> is the beat for reaching affinity n (1..5), then repeatable thanks. <speaker>_chat_affinity: affinity-gated chatter in the NPC's own pool. Generated once, edit freely. affinity_rewards: speaker -> level -> reward. Rewards: currency {id: n} (Progression.add_currency, granted once), stat {player stat: amount} (applied at the start of every run while affinity >= level), unlock (Progression.grant_unlock id, granted once; fallback currency if already owned), text (announced).

lines.text: A sack of souls? For me?
...Hm. Most Sinbound pay me for steel. Nobody pays me for nothing.
I will put them in the quench water. Steel likes a gift too.
Again. You are either soft in the head or you want something.
Fine. Here is something for free: never parry a Lancer. Step aside. They cannot turn.
You keep doing this. People will talk.
...Let them. I have been talked about for six hundred years. It is mostly the hammer they mention.
Sit. No, there. That stool is Darling's. Pip told you about Darling, did he not.
My first anvil. Pulled her out of the Eighth Forge's slag with my own hands. She remembers every blade. I talk to her because she listens.
Now you know. Tell anyone and I will forge you into a doorstop.
Enough gifts. Take this instead.
My mark. Struck into your claws while you were not looking. Every smith in the Pit will know you are under the Ninth Forge's hand.
Do not die stupidly with it on. It would reflect on me.
Hm. Thanks.
Souls in, gratitude out. Grudgingly.
An offering. How quaint. I have not received one since I stopped being worshipped.
...I will pretend it is a hymn. It is the closest thing you have.
You remember my name now. Most do not bother. Ashtongue is easier to say than to love.
Do you want to hear the hymn? The backwards one?
...No. Not yet. It burns the tongue, and you need yours for threatening angels.
Lilaeth had a voice like a struck bell. I had a voice like the silence after it.
When we fell, I fell first. I wanted her to know there was somewhere to land.
Do not tell her that. She would sing about it. Badly.
Come closer. I will sing it after all. Only one note.
There. You will hear that note for the rest of your existence, under everything. It means someone in the Pit is on your side.
Every rite has a price. This one, you paid freely. Strange.
I accept. I always accept. That was the problem, once.
A deposit with no account attached? Highly irregular. I adore it.
I shall open a new ledger for it. Category: inexplicable kindness.
Second unsolicited payment. I am beginning to suspect fraud. Lovely, generous fraud.
Do you know nobody has given me anything since I sold my name? Not even a nod.
People do not give gifts to nobody. You are making a very strange investment, Sinbound.
I remembered something last night. My mother's voice, calling me in for supper.
She was calling a name. I could not hear which one. But she was calling, Sinbound. Someone once called me.
I have made a decision. With you as witness.
When we take the chair and I present the audit, I will sign it. Not as Mammon's Clerk.
I will think of a name. A new one. One nobody can buy. Will you remember it for me?
Credited with interest. Thank you!
Noted, filed, cherished.
A gift? For a mapmaker? Then I shall name a hill after you. A small one, with a nice view of the angels.
Look. I have marked your favourite killing grounds. Little horns, instead of skulls. You have earned horns.
I was a scout, before. For the Host. Did you know? I drew Heaven's maps of Hell.
Then one day I drew a road I was not supposed to see, and followed it down. I never went back up.
Want to know my secret road? There is a path off the Fallen Roads that leads nowhere at all. Just a cliff over the Pit.
I go there to sit. Everything is very small from up there. Even Heaven.
Here. My own compass. It does not point north. It points to wherever I am.
Now you can always find me. Whatever happens at the top of the stairs, find me after. I want the map.
Mapped and grateful.
I shall draw you on the next one. Bigger than the angels.
For ME? Nobody gives imps things! Usually they give us jobs. Or kicks.
I am going to keep this forever. Or until lunch.
You did it again! Are we friends? Is this what friends are? I read about it in a letter once.
Secret! The Duchess snores. Like a furnace with a cough. I have it on parchment.
I have never told anybody this. I was not always an imp. I was a sin. A small one. Somebody's white lie.
They forgot it, so it fell, and it landed here, and it became me. I am a lie nobody remembers telling. Hee.
I am going to follow you up. To the top. To the chair. Do not argue.
Someone has to carry the decrees when you are in charge. And I want a hat. A real one. With a feather. An angel feather.
Hee! Thank you!
Mine! All mine! Thank you!
Tribute for the warden of the gate. Counted. And... appreciated.
You are the first Sinbound to bring the Breachwarden anything but complaints. I will remember it when I count you down.
The halberd was my father's. He kept the gate before me. He went up once, against orders, to see the sky.
He did not come down. I have counted every soul that came down since, looking for him.
I have stopped looking for my father in the count, Sinbound. I started looking for you instead.
That is a kinder thing to wait for.
When you go up the last time, I will come with you as far as the Gate. The Chainward has never left the Breach.
We will make an exception. Chains are for holding on, too.
Counted. Gratefully.
The gate remembers generosity.
Darling says hello. I mean the anvil. Obviously.
I hummed your note today. The lava hummed it back.
Your account has been upgraded to Cherished. It is a new tier. I invented it.
There is a hill on the map with your name on it now. Mind the angels on it.
Best friend! Hello! Best friend!
The count goes better when I know who I am waiting for.
Take this. Ember-Forged Locket. I made it from the first nail I ever drove.
It is still warm. It will stay warm. Wear it down there and hit harder for me.
Keepsake unlocked: Ember-Forged Locket. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
This is a page from the hymnal I sang from, before. One verse. Heaven forgot it.
Carry it up. Let them hear what they forgot.
Keepsake unlocked: Torn Hymnal Page. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
Here. My marked coin. The first soul I ever took in payment. I marked it so I would remember.
Take it on your descents. It earns interest. Everything near it does.
Keepsake unlocked: The Clerk's Marked Coin. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
My compass. No, not that one. The real one. It always points away from Heaven.
Which means, if you are lost up there, it points home.
Keepsake unlocked: Wayfarer's Compass. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
This is my lucky tooth! Well. Somebody's lucky tooth. It is lucky for ME, anyway.
You can borrow it. Bring it back. Please. It is my only tooth that is not in my mouth.
Keepsake unlocked: Pip's Lucky Tooth. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
One link from the chain that held the Breach shut, before we tore it open.
It held a world closed. It can hold you together. Wear it.
Keepsake unlocked: Breachwarden's Link. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
My signet, darling. It opens doors at Court. It closes others, permanently.
Wear it where Heaven can see. Let them know whose weapon you are. For now.
Keepsake unlocked: Ashen Signet. Choose it at the hellgate before you descend.
Tribute. Correctly offered, with the left hand. Someone taught you manners.
Again? Careful, darling. The Court will think you want something.
...You may stand a little closer.
You have earned a favour. I do not grant those often. Ask Pip. Actually, do not.
Do you know why I write letters, darling? Because the last thing I said aloud to someone I trusted, they repeated to a duke.
I do not intend to repeat that mistake. With you, I am... trying.
Enough tribute. Here is mine: when the chair is filled, I will not stand against whoever fills it. If it is you.
That is the most anyone at Court has ever promised anyone. Treasure it.
Tribute received. Noted. Appreciated, in moderation.

5.text: Pip stole the key to Morvane's prison. Morvane is free to walk with you.
